themes.description: Reviews expressing overall satisfaction, positive sentiment, or general praise for the app's features and usability without specific issues.
General positive or negative feedback about the overall application usability, design, and user satisfaction, not related to specific technical issues or financial transactions.
Covers feedback related to the app's user interface, design, layout, and overall user experience.
Covers suggestions for new trading functionalities, improvements to existing trading tools, and enhancements to order management.
Covers issues and questions related to account creation, deactivation, reactivation, profile updates, and other account-specific settings.
This theme covers issues encountered during the installation or initial setup of the application.
This theme covers requests or feedback related to account management functionalities, settings, or features like login options.
This theme covers issues related to the platform's handling of investment opportunities, such as IPO allocations or specific investment product management.
Inquiries or feedback regarding specific investment products, features, or offerings, including new asset classes, investment modes, or tax-efficient structures.
Feedback related to the application's user interface, ease of navigation, clarity of features, and overall user experience, especially after updates.
Feedback or requests related to specific functionalities, data display, or overall user interface design within the application.
Questions or requests related to investment strategies, market timing, or general financial advice.
Covers complaints about persistent bugs, inaccurate data, and the quality of customer support in resolving these technical problems.
Concerns related to user data privacy, unauthorized sharing of personal information, and potential data breaches.
Reviews concerning the absence of expected or desired functionalities, trading options, or application features.
This theme covers feedback related to the ease of use, simplicity, and overall user-friendliness of the application.
This theme covers feedback related to the overall user experience, interface design, ease of use, and accessibility of the application.
This theme covers feedback regarding missing features, limitations in existing functionalities, or requests for new features within the application.
Covers aggressive marketing of financial products like loans, unwanted calls, or persistent promotions that users find intrusive or predatory.
Concerns related to aggressive promotion or unsolicited offers of loans and credit products.
Suggestions for new features, enhancements, or improvements to existing functionalities within the application.
This theme covers problems related to account creation, modification, or closure, including KYC and documentation issues.
